einzeiler: An elderly Florida businessman is found murdered, exposing a web of jealousy and betrayal.
kurzfassung: Tommy Kellum was found murdered and wrapped in a rug inside his Florida home in June 2009. Investigators soon discovered that his much younger partner, Brenda Watson, had fled with the help of her cousin. Following a high-stakes bus manhunt, Watson was captured in Pennsylvania and confessed to the shooting.
stichpunkte: Police discovered the decomposing body of 76-year-old Tommy Kellum wrapped in a rug in his Lake City home.
Kellum and his partner Brenda Watson lived together as roommates following their divorce due to mutual infidelity.
Investigators traced credit card usage and surveillance footage to a Walmart where Brenda and her cousin Jeffrey Love purchased cleaning supplies and a matching rug.
After fleeing toward the Canadian border, Brenda was apprehended by police in Erie, Pennsylvania.
Jeffrey Love was arrested in South Carolina and confessed that Brenda had enlisted him to help cover up the crime.
Brenda provided a detailed confession to police, claiming she snapped after years of emotional mistreatment.
A judge convicted Brenda of second-degree murder after her defense raised a battered woman argument, sentencing her to 30 years in prison.

clips.hook: A gruesome discovery in the Florida heat
clips.text: Forensic examination revealed extreme decomposition and swelling due to the intense summer temperatures inside the unconditioned house.

clips.hook: A damning purchase captured on camera
clips.text: Store security footage connected the suspects to the crime by showing them buying the exact same style of rug used to wrap the victim.
An unsuspecting relative was called to the residence only to realize he had walked in on a covered-up homicide.
The perpetrator retrieved a firearm from the bathroom and fired repeatedly until the weapon was completely empty.

beschreibung:
A grandfather is found shot dead in his home; detectives fear his missing ex-wife is also in danger.
